main_text.l: Æpe est imprudens, alium qui ladere quaerit: Damna parans alijs sæpe sibiipse nocet.
Sæpe & in aduersos telum qui torferat hostes, Heu patitur telo vulnera facta suo.
Sæpe fera foribusq; aliquis non cautius ab-errans
Sæpe quis haud aliter, quam texit aranea telam, Confuit infirmum, si bene cernis, opus.
Aut male conglomerat non conglomeranda, perinde Ac si quis vellet jungere gryphas equis.
Aut audet veluti larva terrere Leonem, Instar & Archilochi fallere vulpis ovem.
Illic ne noceas tibi, circumspectior esto: Texta tua in gyrum, fac, rationis agas:
Hic ne decipiare cave, ut possisq; cavere, Rectius hoc scriptum gnava juventa tene.
Hoc docet argutos bene te referire sophistas, Ne dubita, & verum solvere falsa modum.
Tu vero inprimis magni spes[?] maxima patris Assidua Vultej[?] volve revolve manu.

page.notes: The Greek heading is set in Greek type; its accents are transcribed as read. Long s is rendered as s throughout. "spes" and "Vultej" are doubtful readings, marked [?]. The word "factafuo" in the line "Heu patitur telo vulnera facta suo" is printed with little space and is read as two words. The woodcut ornament at the top and the decorative initial are not text. The signature line is set in a larger italic hand, rendered here with a line break.
